description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, targeting Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve All Aboard, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, causing Skycoach Conductor to become prepared.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
